title: Introduction to org
text: Research projects data analyses can hard manage. problems common: Inconsistent project structures across different analyses. Mixed requirements code (version control), results (sharing), data (security). Collaboration difficulties team members use different folder structures. Version tracking research submissions revisions. Cross-platform compatibility issues file paths. org package solves problems. provides standardized framework organizes R projects. framework gives clear separation concerns, consistent structure across analyses.

title: Introduction to org
text: initialize_project() main function sets project structure. takes two arguments. saves folder locations org::project use throughout analysis: home: Location Run.R R/ folder (accessible via org::project$home). results: Results folder creates date-based subfolders (accessible via org::project$results_today). ...: Additional folders needed (e.g., data_raw, data_clean). max_loc_per_file: largest number code lines one .R file may hold. initialize_project() stops error naming every file limit, sources . default Inf, checks nothing. code line physical line neither blank entirely comment. R parser identifies comments, # inside string hide line. org::loc_per_file() applies count , want see numbers without setting limit.
